newsitem.title: USA: Tandy will register for $300mln offering.
newsitem.headline: Tandy will register for $300mln offering.

text.p: Tandy Corp said Monday it expects to file a $300 million debt registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission within the next ninety days.

Funding under the registration statement will take the form of bonds and/or medium-term notes and will be used to refinance existing short-term indebtedness and for general corporate purposes, said the company.

The comapny said its percentage of long-term debt to total capitalization was only six percent at December 31, and issuance of longer term debt will allow it to obtain long-term funding at favorable rates.
Tandy sells consumer electronic products through approximately 6,800 RadioShack and 92 Computer City outlets.
